en.这是无需登录的无限注德州扑克练习。先了解怎么赢、怎么行动，再用复盘和不同对手练习: Practice no-limit Texas Hold'em without an account. Learn how to win and act, then improve your decisions through reviews and different computer opponents.
en.每人两张底牌，桌上最多发出五张公共牌。从这七张牌中任选五张组成最好的牌，可以用两: Each player receives two hole cards, and up to five community cards are dealt. Make the best five-card hand using any combination of these seven cards: two, one or none of your hole cards. If everyone else folds, the remaining player wins the pot. At showdown, compare the best five-card hands.
en.牌型从强到弱：同花顺 → 四条 → 葫芦 → 同花 → 顺子 → 三条 → 两对: Hand rankings: straight flush → four of a kind → full house → flush → straight → three of a kind → two pair → one pair → high card
en.同一牌型先比组成牌型的点数，再比剩余牌的点数（踢脚）。最佳五张完全相同就平分，花: For equal categories, compare the ranks making the hand, then the kickers. Identical best five-card hands split the pot; suits have equal rank. An ace may be high or low in an A2345 straight.
en.BTN 是庄位，顺时针下一家是 SB（小盲），再下一家是 BB（大盲）。翻牌前从: BTN is the dealer button. Clockwise, the next seat is SB (small blind), followed by BB (big blind). Preflop action starts after the big blind. Postflop action starts with the first player able to act clockwise from the button. Later position lets you see more actions first. The button advances one seat after each hand.
en.全下后只能争夺自己有投入的部分。筹码多的人继续下注会形成边池，各池分别比较；弃牌: An all-in player can win only the pots they contributed to. Further betting may create side pots, settled separately. Folded contributions remain in the pot, but folded players are ineligible to win. Uncalled excess is refunded; a refund is not an additional award.
en.EV 是长期重复一种打法的预期筹码收益，一次赢牌不能证明长期赚钱。复盘根据你行动: EV is the expected chip return when a strategy is repeated over time; winning one hand does not prove positive long-term EV. Reviews use before-action information and assumed opponent ranges. They do not grade choices using hidden opponent cards or future cards, and do not guarantee optimal play or a win. Switch to Opponent reasoning to inspect the computer’s actual decision trace.

en.安全单挑翻牌上，强顶对也可能先过牌；湿面、多人或浅码时优先保护价值。: On safe heads-up flops, a strong top pair may check first. Wet boards, multiway pots and short stacks favor protecting value.
en.更常通过跟注进入底池，成强牌后用较大尺度取值；便宜跟入并不代表会接下所有大注。: More often enters by calling, then uses larger value bets with strong hands. A cheap preflop call does not mean calling every large bet.
en.特色路线是前位收紧、后位主动争夺未开启的底池，低价先跟与延迟进攻作为有位置时的补: The signature is tighter early-position play and actively contesting unopened pots late. Cheap floats and delayed aggression are additional options in position.
en.特色路线是收紧入池与昂贵防守，选中起手牌后仍正常下注取值。: The signature is selective entry and disciplined defense against expensive bets, followed by normal value betting with selected hands.
en.更常用跟注进入便宜底池，安全强牌保留诱导，面对高成本仍会退出。: Tends to call into cheap pots, retains traps with safe strong hands, and folds when the price is too high.
en.低成本时更倾向跟入而非主动加注，仍按起手牌范围和筹码压力筛选。: At low prices prefers calling to raising, while still filtering hands by range and stack pressure.
en.特色路线是低价先跟保留对手，命中安全强牌后选择过牌或跟注诱导，危险局面恢复价值进: Often starts with a cheap call to keep opponents in, then checks or calls with safe strong hands to induce action. On dangerous boards returns to value aggression.
en.可以用位置和价值牌隔离，但不能把它的每次跟注都当成弱牌。: Use position and value hands to isolate, but do not treat every call as a weak hand.
en.更宽地参与底池，合适的后街偏向大尺度取值，并保留有依据的诈唬。: Enters more pots, favors larger value bets on suitable later streets, and retains supported bluffs.
en.特色路线是在合适的转牌或河牌用大尺度增加对手的继续成本，中等牌力仍会控制投入。: Its signature line uses large bets on suitable turns or rivers to increase the cost of continuing, while medium-strength hands still limit their investment.
en.公共牌已有三张同花色，对手若持两张该花色的底牌，就能组成同花，领先当前成牌。: There are three cards of one suit on the board. An opponent with two hole cards of that suit can make a flush and beat the current made hand.
en.公共牌已有至少四张同花色，对手只需一张该花色的底牌，就能组成同花，领先当前成牌。: There are at least four cards of one suit on the board. An opponent needs only one hole card of that suit to make a flush and beat the current made hand.
en.公共牌已配对，对手可能组成葫芦或四条，这些牌会领先当前成牌。: The board is paired. An opponent may have a full house or four of a kind, either of which would beat the current made hand.

en.后续公共牌再配对时，这手三条还有改善为葫芦或四条的机会。: If the board pairs on a later card, this three of a kind can still improve to a full house or four of a kind.
en.后面仍有玩家可以下注，过牌不保证本轮无需再付筹码。: Other players can still bet. Checking does not guarantee that no more chips will be needed this betting round.
en.后面还有玩家可以下注，过牌为诱导其弱牌或诈唬继续投入留下机会。: Other players can still bet. Checking leaves room to induce further bets with weaker hands or bluffs.
en.当前成牌保留了摊牌机会，过牌控制投入，也避免下注后只留下更强的继续范围。: The current made hand retains showdown value. Checking limits the investment and avoids betting only to have stronger hands continue.

en.虽然已经成同花，对手仍可能用更高的同花领先，不能只看成花就把筹码全部投入。: Even with a made flush, an opponent could hold a higher flush. Making a flush alone is not a reason to commit the entire stack.
en.过牌先不主动做大底池，保留遇到下注后再判断的空间。: Checking keeps the pot from growing for now and leaves room to reassess if a bet follows.
en.过牌的代价是对手也可能免费见到下一张，补成更强的牌。: The cost of checking is that an opponent may also see the next card for free and improve to a stronger hand.
